content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-8|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators worldwide face barriers when it comes to accepting payments, especially in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are not available. If you're in Nigeria, Ghana, or elsewhere, the challenge of setting up an online store can seem insurmountable. However, with the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-6|The Full]], you can deploy your digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-17|cloudflare]] Pages for free and bypass traditional payment systems entirely. This guide details a step-by-step process for deploying your store using COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, ensuring you maintain full control over your digital assets while accepting crypto payments seamlessly.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment systems often fail digital creators in many regions due to restrictions and high fees. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed for creators who need sovereignty over their digital commerce. By leveraging platforms like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you eliminate dependencies on third-party services. This architecture allows you to own your store and data completely, ensuring you are not at the mercy of fluctuating policies or service outages. You can deploy a resilient, scalable online store capable of handling crypto transactions without the burdens imposed by conventional platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your digital store, you must gather several essential components. First, set up a Cloudflare account to access its Pages and Workers services. You will also need to familiarize yourself with GitHub for hosting your code. Additionally, create a NOWPayments account to manage your cryptocurrency transactions seamlessly. Lastly, ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, whether they are eBooks, courses, or software. This preparation will streamline your deployment process and ensure you're ready to go live in record time.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery pipeline, start by configuring your Cloudflare Pages to host your store's frontend. Use GitHub to manage your project's code repository, ensuring it's publicly accessible. Next, implement Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic, which allows you to process orders and manage product delivery efficiently. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions, ensuring you have an array of cryptocurrencies available for your customers. Finally, configure your file delivery system, using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to ensure customers receive their purchased products instantly after payment confirmation.
You own your store and data completely after deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Ensure all components are functioning correctly by conducting thorough testing on the mainnet. After confirming everything works as intended, promote your store through social media or other channels to attract your audience. As customers begin to place orders, monitor the transaction process closely. With NOWPayments, you will receive instant verification of payments as they occur on-chain. This quick confirmation means your customers receive their digital products immediately, enhancing their overall experience and trust in your store.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is operational, consider strategies for scaling your business. Evaluate the data you collect from customer transactions to identify popular products and potential market trends. You may want to increase your product offerings or consider collaborations with other creators. Utilize Supabase to manage your database effectively and gather insights from your sales data. As your store grows, leverage the Edge Commerce Stack's features, such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations for email deliverability, to enhance your marketing efforts. This proactive approach will ensure your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and sales.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments. Start by setting up a Cloudflare account and deploying your store on Pages. Integrate NOWPayments for smooth cryptocurrency transactions. This architecture enables you to maintain full ownership of your store and data, all without relying on traditional payment platforms.
No monthly fees or subscriptions — just one-time payments.

Explore other related searches such as GitHub Pages digital store crypto payments free hosting and learn about our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a fully tested deployment in just 48 hours. You can find more about our offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

To set up a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, create a Cloudflare account. Then, deploy your site using GitHub to host your code. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and ensure your products are ready for delivery.
What payments can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies. This flexibility ensures that you can cater to a global audience without traditional payment barriers.
Can I use GitHub Pages for my digital store?
Yes, GitHub Pages can host your digital store. However, for enhanced capabilities like backend processing and database management, consider using Cloudflare Pages combined with Cloudflare Workers.
